types.name: Auto Attack
types.description: This will let you automatically melee attack when you are in range of a valid target

types.name: Custom Buff
types.description: This is a buff created by a player

types.name: Focus
types.description: A sustained Nexus focus: moderate power, speed, regeneration, and recovery at a continuous energy cost.

types.name: Custom Buff
types.description: This is a buff created by a player

types.name: Muscle Force
types.description: A grounded physical style that reinforces strength and durability.

types.name: Combat Mathematics
types.description: Predictive calculations improve accuracy, reflex and measured movement.

types.name: Ki Blade
types.description: Condenses energy around close-range attacks, balancing strength, force and accuracy.

types.name: Magic Force
types.description: Arcane circulation improves force, resistance and recovery.

types.name: Offensive Stance
types.description: A committed attacking posture that trades defense for strength and accuracy.

types.name: Defensive Stance
types.description: A guarded posture that trades offense for durability and reflex.

types.name: Bleeding Edge
types.description: A dangerous speed style that sharpens strength and accuracy at a durability cost.

types.name: Burning Fist
types.description: Ignites a relentless close-range rhythm that favors strength and offense.

types.name: Ki Fist
types.description: Channels force through unarmed strikes and reinforces their accuracy.

types.name: Demonic Fury
types.description: A ferocious style with high power, strength and regeneration but reduced reflex.

types.name: Angelic Grace
types.description: A serene high-mobility style that improves speed, reflex and recovery.

types.name: Channel
types.description: Sacrifices movement to expand energy, force and recovery for sustained casting.

types.name: Custom Buff
types.description: This is a buff created by a player

types.name: High Tension
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring raw power and durability.

types.name: Godspeed
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring extreme movement, accuracy, and reflex.

types.name: Fists of Fury
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring strength and relentless offense.

types.name: Arcane Power
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring energy capacity, force, and recovery.

types.name: Bestial Wrath
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring ferocity, strength, and regeneration.

types.name: Bushido
types.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring balanced weapon combat and precision.

types.name: Hundred Crack Fist
types.description: A sustained rush of twenty-four or more rapid strikes. Each hit deals increased melee damage, but the technique never executes the target or knocks out its user.

types.name: Ki Weapon
types.description: Shape Ki into a reliable close-combat weapon. Its tier follows your Ki Weapon proficiency.

types.name: Ki Fist
types.description: Wraps the hands in Ki and adds 30% of Force to melee scaling. With a physical weapon this becomes Embue, retaining only the weapon's BP reinforcement.

types.name: Ki Sword
types.description: Shapes a light Ki blade. Adds 70% of Force to melee scaling and carries a sword accuracy penalty, but does not unlock weapon techniques.

types.name: Ki Hammer
types.description: Shapes a heavy Ki hammer. Adds 100% of Force to melee scaling, counts as a weapon and trades speed and accuracy for impact.

types.name: Spirit Sword
types.description: The highest Ki Weapon discipline. Adds 70% of Force to melee scaling, attacks Resistance through energy and counts as a weapon.

types.name: Nexus Stance
types.description: Adopt a temporary combat stance. Only one Nexus stance can be active at a time.

types.name: Block
types.description: Brace for eight seconds: take 30% less final damage and gain 20 percentage points of blast evasion, but lose 20% effective Strength, Force and Reflex.

types.name: Viltrumite Guard
types.description: Brace for two seconds. The next frontal attack deals 40% less final damage and gives you a personal opening against its attacker.

types.name: Guard Break
types.description: Adopt an unarmed stance for ten seconds. Your next three landed melee attacks each reduce the target's effective Reflex by 10% for eight seconds, stacking to 30%.

types.name: Critical Edge
types.description: Adopt a weapon-exclusive stance for twelve seconds, adding 15 percentage points to melee critical chance.

types.name: Nexus Melee Technique
types.description: A Nexus technique adapted to the Nexus combat engine.

types.name: Slice
types.description: A fast weapon strike with regular damage and a very short cooldown.

types.name: Bash
types.description: Bash with a hammer or sword pommel, sacrificing damage to stun the target.

types.name: Flourish
types.description: An elaborate weapon strike that converts speed into stronger impact.

types.name: Wind Howl
types.description: Unleash a true area slicing shockwave that strikes enemies within three tiles without requiring a selected target.

types.name: Iai Slash
types.description: Rush up to six tiles and strike through the target with a speed-amplified slash.

types.name: Riposte
types.description: Ready your equipped weapon and counter the next incoming melee attack within four seconds.

types.name: Cleave
types.description: Sweep the three tiles in front of you with increased accuracy and damage.

types.name: Sword Stab
types.description: A focused stab that pierces the adjacent target and a second target directly behind them.

types.name: Overhead Smash
types.description: A heavy, less accurate overhead attack that crashes through three tiles in a straight line.

types.name: Colossal Impact
types.description: Drive your weapon down and unleash a gigantic close-range shockwave.

types.name: Burning Slash
types.description: A three-hit weapon combo whose finishing strike tears open a bleeding wound.

types.name: Headbutt
types.description: A blunt close-range strike with a brief stagger.

types.name: Uppercut Combo
types.description: A three-hit rising combination whose final uppercut launches the target.

types.name: Axe Kick
types.description: A descending kick with strong knockback.

types.name: Kickback Combo
types.description: Knock the target away, pursue them with afterimages and land a second hit unless they block.

types.name: March of Fury
types.description: Pursue the selected target through movement and deliver four separately resolved melee attacks.

types.name: Pile Driver
types.description: Requires a grabbed opponent; invert and slam them head-first with an unavoidable impact.

types.name: Megaton Throw
types.description: Requires a grabbed opponent; leap with them, slam them down and throw them away.

types.name: Consecutive Normal Punches
types.description: Telegraph briefly, then unleash six separately resolved unarmed hits on an adjacent target.

types.name: Exploding Heart Strike
types.description: A precise unarmed strike that deals heavy damage and internal bleeding.

types.name: Texas Smash
types.description: A slow, devastating unarmed blow with extreme knockback.

types.name: Wing Clip
types.description: Sweep every opponent within two tiles with an unavoidable low-damage kick, knocking them back and reducing Speed by 25% for eight seconds.

types.name: Sand Throw
types.description: Scatter sand around you with unavoidable accuracy, reducing nearby opponents' Accuracy and Reflex by 20% for eight seconds.

types.name: Burning Shot
types.description: Warp into range and land a fiery three-hit unarmed combination.

types.name: Blue Comet Special
types.description: A speed-focused advancing assault adapted as a long-range five-hit rush.

types.name: Comet Reversal
types.description: Counter a hostile beam from the front, rush its owner and strike on reaching them.

types.name: Nexus Melee Technique
types.description: A Nexus technique adapted to the Nexus combat engine.

types.name: Viltrumite Rush
types.description: Surge up to seven tiles into a target. The impact opens their guard, enables Relentless Pursuit and briefly staggers them against solid terrain.

types.name: Rib Breaker
types.description: Drive a compact strike into an adjacent target, briefly staggering them and creating a personal combat opening.

types.name: Relentless Pursuit
types.description: Consume the pursuit window on a target you recently launched and close up to ten tiles without dealing damage.

types.name: Conqueror's Grip
types.description: Seize an adjacent unguarded opponent after a low-damage strike, preparing them for a grapple technique.

types.name: Meteor Drop
types.description: Requires a grabbed opponent. Rise with them and drive them into the ground, opening and briefly staggering them.

types.name: Spear Hand
types.description: A focused adjacent hand thrust with high damage, no knockback and severe bleeding. Combat openings improve its accuracy.

types.name: Nolan's Combination
types.description: Close four tiles and attempt four individually resolved strikes, ending in a bleeding knife-hand slash. Blocking or evading interrupts the sequence.

types.name: Punishing Reversal
types.description: For one second, counter the next frontal melee attack with a low-damage elbow that staggers and creates a combat opening.

types.name: Nexus Special Style
types.description: A Nexus attack whose behavior is not represented by a generic blast.

types.name: Wall of Flame
types.description: Create a persistent five-tile wall of fire that damages and briefly stuns enemies who enter it.

types.name: Nexus Special Style
types.description: A charged Nexus projectile adapted to Nexus Exodus combat scaling.

types.name: Dragon Nova
types.description: A giant charged energy sphere adapted from Nexus. It is slow, explosive, and intended as a Force finisher.

types.name: Sky Break
types.description: A weapon swing that breaks the sound barrier and launches a Strength-scaled cutting blast.

types.name: Echoing Slash
types.description: A fast weapon swing that launches a physical cutting wave with sword audiovisuals and no blast explosion.

types.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
types.description: Create three copies of yourself that relentlessly pursue one selected target. Their shared damage budget prevents the volley from multiplying without limit.

types.name: Evasive Barrage
types.description: Leap 8 to 12 tiles backward based on Speed while releasing eight independently paced pursuing blasts from your leading side.

types.name: Sphere of Destruction
types.description: Launch a concentrated one-tile sphere with very high tracking accuracy. It slowly pursues for 10 to 40 seconds, or 60 seconds at overwhelming Energy efficiency; multiple spheres may coexist.

types.name: Aura of Destruction
types.description: Surround yourself with a damaging four-tile aura that suppresses enemy teleports and dashes. While active, it stops your Energy recovery, drains heavy Energy and reduces movement speed by 30%.

types.name: Death Laser
types.description: Fire an instantaneous, needle-thin laser that pierces every valid target in a thirty-tile line without charging or becoming a beam struggle.

types.name: Shockwave
types.description: This emits a shockwave that will knockback anyone within range, dealing some damage. It does damage based on your strength + force, compared to the target's durability + resistance

types.name: Nexus Area Technique
types.description: A specialized targetless shockwave adapted from Nexus.

types.name: Super Explosive Wave
types.description: Detonate a violent eight-tile shockwave that destroys hostile blasts and hurls enemies up to twelve tiles away.

types.name: Earthquake
types.description: Collapse the ground inward across an eight-tile radius, damaging and pulling grounded enemies toward you. Flying targets are unaffected.

types.name: Genki Dama
types.description: A massive chargeable bomb. Press it once to start charging, press it again to fire. Guide it with the directional keys. At full charge its impact and explosion make it the strongest player damage technique in the game, so only use it if you want to kill someone.

types.name: Death Ball
types.description: A fast moving chargeable energy ball that does high damage and also stuns whoever it hits

types.name: Supernova
types.description: A fast-charging energy sphere with a massive explosion and high area damage, balanced by its slow travel speed.

types.name: Kikoho
types.description: This attack damages and stuns and grounds whoever it hits. It is an invisible projectile that hits instantly and can not be deflected, and can be spammed repeatedly. It damages the user over time stuns them also, and can kill them. It can not kill people with death regeneration. It can be countered by anything that knocks the person firing it away, or time freezing them.

types.name: Noob Ray
types.description: The most powerful beam in the game, and it doesn't tell the target who killed them.

types.name: Buster Barrage
types.description: An attack which shoots energy from all parts of your body in random directions.

types.name: Attack Barrier
types.description: An offensive and defensive move that makes many balls of ki swarm around you and whatever enters the barrier will be attacked by them. Press the command once to begin firing the balls, press it again when you feel you have fired enough. The more you fire the more it will drain your energy. This ability protects the user from all explosion damage.

types.name: Blast
types.description: Fire blasts rapidly

types.name: Big Bang Attack
types.description: Basicly a more powerful version of the 'charge' ki attack

types.name: Charge
types.description: An explosive one-shot energy attack that takes a few seconds to charge.

types.name: Cyber Charge
types.description: This artificial attack is designed to mimic charge. It is a bit weaker but can be fired twice as fast.

types.name: Kienzan
types.description: A guidable, piercing energy disk that cannot damage its owner.

types.name: Spin Blast
types.description: Shoot many small blasts in every direction continuously

types.name: Makosen
types.description: A very, very powerful attack, widespread and very destructive. Made up of many smaller shots that inflict a lot of damage all together. It is very draining, not very long range, and has a long charge time.

types.name: Time Stop
types.description: Expand an eight-tile cosmic domain that overwhelms every valid target inside it. Targets are stunned longer when your BP and Force overcome their BP and Resistance. Time Normalizers greatly reduce the stun.

types.name: Explosion
types.description: This attack causes an explosion on the ground, the more you use it the bigger the explosion

types.name: Scatter Shot
types.description: This will create multiple homing balls all around an opponent, and when its done they will all collide at once on top of them. Individually each ball is weak, but all together it can be extremely devastating to most people. The more energy you get the more balls you can make at once.

types.name: Sokidan
types.description: A guided energy bomb that deals equal impact and splash damage and cannot damage its owner.

types.name: Genocide
types.description: This is a very weak attack, about the power of a single blast, but each one homes in on your selected target across the planet. Press it once to begin firing, again to stop.

types.name: Nexus Beam
types.description: A Nexus beam adapted to the Nexus beam engine.

types.name: Double Sunday
types.description: A wide corkscrew beam with strong knockback and balanced charge time.

types.name: Photon Flash
types.description: A fast, efficient beam that trades impact for reach and control.

types.name: Tyrant Lancer
types.description: A narrow offensive beam designed to pierce shields and distant targets.

types.name: Buster Cannon
types.description: A slow, high-drain cannon beam built for raw impact.

types.name: RockThrow
types.description: You throw a rock at your opponent and deal damage with your strength.

types.name: RockSlide
types.description: You throw lots of rocks at your opponent and deal damage with your strength. Each projectile is slightly weaker than Rock Throw.

types.name: RockTomb
types.description: You throw a massive rock at your opponent and deal heavy damage with your strength. When mastered this rock explodes!

types.name: Giant Form
types.description:
Using this will make you bigger:
20% bp increase (50% for makyos)
25% speed, reflex, offense decrease
25% strength, endurance, and resist increase

types.name: Limit Breaker
types.description: x1.5 BP, x3 Regeneration, x3 Recovery. x3 Accuracy. When you activate this it lasts for a random period of time, at the end of which you will be knocked out. It is very powerful but it is a big gamble on your chances of winning or losing a fight.

types.name: Hide Energy
types.description: Using this ability will cause you to be hidden from sense, observe, and teleports. The drawback is that while using it your available bp is very low

types.name: Dash Attack
types.description: A targeted melee finisher that rushes directly through the selected opponent. Its damage increases with the distance crossed.

types.name: Soul Contract
types.description: You can offer someone a soul contract. If they accept, their soul will belong to you, and you will get certain powers over them.

types.name: Soul Weapon
types.description: Mold your Soul power into a weapon that affects the world in a variety of ways.

types.name: Soul Attack
types.description: Encase your soul into an attack

types.name: Meditate Level 2
types.description: Meditate Level 2 allows you to use meditation as a form of training. Without this skill, meditate is only good for recovering health and energy faster.

types.name: Sense Level 1
types.description: The ability to sense everyone on the planet. You can see their overall power, which is their BP, stats, and everything else combined into a percent.

types.name: Sense Level 2
types.description: By clicking on someone you will open a tab which will let you see their overall power, health, and energy, and possibly other details that basic sense does not tell you.

types.name: Sense Level 3
types.description: This requires Sense Level 2 to work. When you open a tab of a person by clicking them, you will see many details of that person, like their stats, as well as many other useful things.

types.name: Shadow Spar
types.description: This is a special form of training where your character is being attacked by an imaginary target and you must face them in time to defend yourself. It is quite a good method of training but requires you to actually be active.

types.name: Regeneration
types.description: This is a passive healing skill where, if your health goes below 100% you will begin trading energy for health. You can turn it on and off at any time.

types.name: Give Power
types.description: You can transfer your health and energy to someone from a distance. The person can exceed 100% power if you have enough health and energy, exceeding 100% energy raises their BP. The effect is only temporary, because health and energy do not stay above 100% for long.

types.name: Zanzoken
types.description: Zanzoken is the ability to use a burst of concentrated speed to reach a place very fast, it is so fast it is basically like teleporting a short distance. You click the spot you want to go to and your character will suddenly go there. The more you master this the less energy it will drain. You will also get a new command in the skills tab that lets you chase someone down using zanzoken if they try to run from you

types.name: Keep Body
types.description: Using this on someone will allow them to keep most of their power while dead.

types.name: Shield
types.description: You can toggle this on and off. A ki shield will surround you to protect you from all attacks. Each attack will drain your energy instead of health. The shield will also protect you from dying in space but it will drain energy heavily.

types.name: Make Power Fruit
types.description: With this you can make fruits that will increase the power and energy of those who eat them, along with a temporary boost to regeneration and recovery. The more of them you eat however, the less of an effect they will have each time.

types.name: Bind
types.description: You can use this to bind someone to hell. You can only bind a person who is less than your own power at the time. The stronger they are compared to you the more energy it will drain to bind them

types.name: Absorb
types.description: You can absorb a knocked out person. You will get a power increase based on how strong they are compared to you. Absorbing people can also bring you back to life, by absorbing either 1 living person or multiple dead people (on average 5 but it is luck based), their base BP must also be more than 75% of yours and they can not be an alt or npc.

types.name: Instant Transmission
types.description: Shunkan Ido, also known as Instant Transmission, is self-explanatory. If you know a person's energy you can teleport to them. Anyone next to you will also be teleported.

types.name: Kai Teleport
types.description: Teleport to any planet. This will drain all your energy. Anyone who is beside you will be taken with you.

types.name: Power Control
types.description: This allows you to power up and power down. Also, for certain forms, such as those of Saiyans and Frost Lords, powering up twice will cause them to go into their next form, powering down twice will cause them to revert. Powering up will increase your Battle Power, but drain your energy the higher you go. Energy Efficiency determines how far above 100% you can go before the upkeep begins increasing sharply.

types.name: Fly
types.description: Obviously this lets you fly. But it drains energy to do so. The more you use it the more you master it, and the more you master it, the less it drains. Also you can decrease the drain to a lesser level by simply gaining more energy, but the effect is not the same as mastering the move itself. This will let you move much faster than you can by walking.

types.name: Self Destruct
types.description: Using this will kill you. It is an extremely powerful attack, one of the top 3 at least. It will affect a large area. If you have death regeneration this attack is much weaker.

types.name: Revive
types.description: This will bring someone back to life. Just face them and use it

types.name: Heal
types.description: You can heal anyone in front of you by giving up some of your own health and energy. If they have certain status problems they can be further alleviated by healing them, with multiple heals they may be cured.

types.name: Unlock Potential
types.description: Using this on someone will greatly increase their power and energy. Each use will add 5 years to how long you must wait to use it on someone again.

types.name: Solar Flare
types.description: Solar Flare blinds people. The range increases the higher your energy mod is. The time you will be blinded is solely dependent on your regeneration stat. How strong the person using Solar Flare does not affect the duration.

types.name: Imitate Player
types.description: You can use this on someone to imitate them in almost every way, so much so that you may be confused with them. You can hit it again to stop imitating.

types.name: Invisibility
types.description: You can use this to make yourself invisible. Some people with very good senses will still know you are there, or if they have visors capable of seeing invisible objects.

types.name: Materialize
types.description: This ability lets you create weighted clothes to accelerate training and also create swords. Your energy mod will improve the quality of weights you make.

types.name: Majin
types.description:
Majin does the following:
20% BP increase
20% stronger anger
x1.5 drain from all attacks
Decreased delay between lunge attacks

types.name: Restore Youth
types.description: You can use this to make someone younger. Each time they get this done they get less and less from it.

types.name: SplitForm
types.description: This will make a copy of yourself, made of energy. It has much the same power as you, and makes a good sparring partner or assistant in battle. You can command their actions by clicking on them. When one is destroyed by someone you lose health and energy. You can not recover health or energy while they are out.

types.name: Simulator
types.description: This can create holographic simulations which can be sparred with to enhance training. Click it to bring up the options menu. This is less convenient than splitforms, but they take 3x more damage than splitforms but do only 0.35x damage to you. Making them better and longer training for most people.

types.name: Simulation Crystal
types.description: A crystal-bound version of the native simulator, adapted from Nexus.

types.name: Holy Pendant
types.description: This pendant protects people from the tortures of hell

types.name: Brain Scrambler Blocker
types.description: Having this on you will block brain scrambler waves from affecting you

types.name: EMP Mine
types.description: Throw this or leave it lying around and it will detonate if anyone gets near it and release an electro magnetic pulse that will severely drain an android's energy

types.name: Teleport Nullifier
types.description: Simply having this on you will prevent anyone within a certain range from being able to use form of teleportation. It is great for stopping runners from teleporting away.

types.name: Scrapper
types.description: Use this on any technology in front of you to scrap it and recieve any resources that can be salvaged. The better your speed, the faster you will scrap things.

types.name: Blood bag
types.description: Used to extract blood from someone. Then drink it. When a vampire drinks this their hunger goes away, the downside is that it rises back up even faster than before. Only biting a person will set it back to normal. You can use it to drink blood from vampires but this is just like biting a vampire and will cause your hunger to raise back up even faster.

types.name: Call bounty drone
types.description: Use this to call a bounty drone to you, it will then send any incapacitated prisoners nearby to prison.

types.name: Radar
types.description: This radar can be set to detect any item. Click it to equip it and a tab will open showing those items.

types.name: Door Hacker
types.description: This device has the ability to bypass walls and doors below it's level

types.name: Devil Mat
types.description: Meditating on this mat will actually DECREASE the stat you are focused on. This can be useful if you are at the stat cap but you don't like how you trained your stats, so you want to lower yourself below the stat cap and train a different stat. This will have no effect if you are focused on energy or balanced.

types.name: Medical Scan
types.description: This displays information about your character's health. Just click it while next to it or have it on you and click it.

types.name: Nav System
types.description: This upgradeable navigation system allows you to find planets in space. The only thing you need to do is have it on you when in space and a navigation tab will open up. It will only show planets that it has been upgraded to find. The more money you put into it the more planets will be unlocked. The rarest planets will be unlocked last and at the greatest cost.

types.name: Resource Vaccuum
types.description: Click this when it is in your items and it will suck up all resource bags lying around you.

types.name: Key
types.description: Click this to set it's password. Door's will check if it is correct and only let you in if it is.

types.name: Advanced Door Pass
types.description: An expensive adaptive pass that can open password-secured doors without storing their password.

types.name: Cloning Tank
types.description: This will revive you each time you are killed. Each time you are cloned however, you lose some of your lifespan, and part of your power will become hidden potential.

types.name: Hacking Console
types.description: If this is upgraded past the upgrade level of a door, it can open the door for you.

types.name: Force Field
types.description: Having this on you will protect you against energy attacks so long as its energy remains. Each shot it deflects drains the battery. Having this on you will reduce the rate you leech power from others because you are not using your own power to defend yourself, but the power of the force field. If the force field reaches 0 it will cause an explosion strong enough to knock you out.

types.name: Detonator
types.description: This can be used to activate the detonation sequence on bombs or missiles from afar.

types.name: Cloak Controls
types.description: You can use this to activate or deactivate all cloaked objects matching the same password you have set for the controls. You can also use this to remove the cloaking chip from objects next to you by using uninstall on it. You can upgrade this to have more cloaking capability so that it is harder to detect. This is also a personal cloak, if you activate it, you will become out of phase, and stay out of phase until you deactivate it. While out of phase you will also see anything that is in the same phase or lower than yourself. The personal cloak is 5 levels less powerful than the cloaking modules themselves.

types.name: Cloak
types.description: You can install this on any object to cloak it using cloak controls. First you must set the password so that it matches the password of your cloak controls or it cannot be activated by those controls.

types.name: Communicator
types.description: Use this to call somebody who also has a cell phone. Just use Say or Whisper and you can talk to them til the call has ended. You end a call by hitting Use again. Anyone within 1 space of you can hear your conversation and also be heard on the cell phone

types.name: Stun Chip
types.description: You can install this on someone and use the Stun Remote to stun them temporarily. To use the remote to stun them your remote must share the same remote access code as the installed chip. You can also use this to remove chips from somebody using the Remove command, both chips will be destroyed in the process.

types.name: Stun Controls
types.description: You can use this to activate a stun chip you have installed on somebody. It only works on people within range.

types.name: Telepad
types.description: You can use this to teleport yourself between other pads sharing the same remote access code

types.name: Telewatch
types.description: You can use this to teleport yourself to any telepad that matches your watch's remote access code. Or to any player who has a telewatch with a matching code.

types.name: Intelligence Booster
types.description: This will raise your intelligence. The lower your intelligence the greater the effect. You can only use this once. This can not be used on people who already have 1x or more intelligence.

types.name: Youthenasia
types.description: This extends life. The more you use them the less effect they will have.

types.name: LSD
types.description: This drug will cause you to see weird stuff. All effects are short lasting and temporary.

types.name: Fruit
types.description: Eating this will increase your power. Each one you eat gives you less.

types.name: Moon
types.description: Using this will turn nearby Saiyans that still have tails into Great_Ape

types.name: PDA
types.description: This can be used to store information, even youtube videos.

types.name: Weights
types.description: Wearing these will greatly increase BP gain and how fast you will catch up while fighting a stronger opponent. Attacks will take much more energy than normal, and your available BP will be lowered while wearing them.

types.name: Regenerator
types.description: Stepping into this will accelerate your healing rate. It heals faster the more upgraded it is. It will break in the strain of high gravity.

types.name: Armor
types.description: Armor will increase certain protective stats and decrease certain stats related to mobility or flexibility. You'll just have to try it on to see exactly what effect it has. The more protective an armor is the more it will decrease stats related to mobility and/or flexibility.

types.name: Forged
types.description: Armor will increase certain protective stats and decrease certain stats related to mobility or flexibility. You'll just have to try it on to see exactly what effect it has. The more protective an armor is the more it will decrease stats related to mobility and/or flexibility.

types.name: Copper
types.description: Armor will increase certain protective stats and decrease certain stats related to mobility or flexibility. You'll just have to try it on to see exactly what effect it has. The more protective an armor is the more it will decrease stats related to mobility and/or flexibility.

types.name: Iron
types.description: Armor will increase certain protective stats and decrease certain stats related to mobility or flexibility. You'll just have to try it on to see exactly what effect it has. The more protective an armor is the more it will decrease stats related to mobility and/or flexibility.

types.name: Mythril
types.description: Armor will increase certain protective stats and decrease certain stats related to mobility or flexibility. You'll just have to try it on to see exactly what effect it has. The more protective an armor is the more it will decrease stats related to mobility and/or flexibility.

types.name: Auracite

types.description: This will help increase the speed at which you can dig up resources.

types.name: Hand Drill
types.description: This will help increase the speed at which you can dig up resources.

types.name: Nexus Pickaxe
types.description: The Nexus mining pickaxe. Equip it to improve excavation yield.

types.name: Hover Chair
types.description: This will let you have fully functional flying abilities.

types.name: Sensu Bean
types.description: This sensu bean will heal you fast. If you plant this, it will grow more over time. It will only grow if a player is nearby.

types.name: Shikon Jewel
types.description: This jewel is ancient and grants power to those who possess it. The jewel is very well known to demons due to the many who have possessed it, so it is possible that many demons know of its existance already.

types.name: Focusin
types.description: Injecting yourself with this will decrease your decline age by 8 years. But for 5 minutes you will rapidly leech power from those around you. You must inject it into your eyes. There is a 10% chance you will immediately die. You can only leech up to 85% of a person's BP using this. Each use decreases zenkai mod by 20% and leech mod by 20%. The effects can be undone magically by the Kaioshin, but you will also lose the BP you leeched, but keep any BP you gained legit.

types.name: RAGE
types.description: Using this will immediately send you into a drug induced rage, raising your battle power by half of what your normal anger usually gives. Decreases you decline by only 2 months. You can only get the full heal from this once every 10 minutes

types.name: Steroids
types.description: BP up, force down, resistance down, speed down, defense down, recovery down, lifespan down. Steroids make you unable to mate. All effects are temporary except the lifespan decrease. The more you take, or the more upgraded they are, the greater the advantages and disadvantages.

types.name: Nuke
types.description: This bomb can cause extreme damage over a large distance. It can be mounted to other objects by having it in your items, facing the object you want to mount the bomb to, right click the bomb and click Mount

types.name: Sonic Bomb
types.description: This bomb only harms people, not objects. It can kill. It can be mounted to any other object

types.name: DNA Container
types.description: This can be used to store DNA from whoever you use it on. Which can be used to clone them. You can only use this on someone who is knocked out or paralyzed. After it has DNA in it, you can go to a Genetics Computer and use it to make a clone, and possibly more.

types.name: Blueprint
types.description: This can hold the design schematics for an Android Body or other science items, so that they can be mass produced. Just face the item you want to have blueprinted, or have the item in your contents, and hit the 'Use' verb to assign the item to be blueprinted, once that is done hitting Use any more times will make a new copy of the blueprinted item. Hit the 'Reset' verb to make the blueprint blank again.

types.name: Robotics Tools
types.description: This is used to increase the cybernetic BP of a cyborg. If they are not already a cyborg, this will make them into one. There are disadvantages to having cybernetic BP, such as inability to ascend, slower training, and inability to turn Super Saiyan. All of the negative effects will go away when your cybernetic BP wears off.

types.name: Ammo
types.description: Click this to reload whichever gun you want.

types.name: Land Mine
types.description: A mine that is mostly buried under the ground out of sight and when someone steps on it or picks up an object sitting on top of it, KABOOM.

types.name: Mana Pylon
types.description: A stationary focus that increases nearby Arcane Essence gathering by 25%.

types.name: Spell Book
types.description: A grimoire that catalogs every spell and formula unlocked in the Magic progression tree.

types.name: Magic Gauntlets
types.description: Enchanted gauntlets that increase Magic XP gains by 5% while carried.

types.name: Orb of Mastery
types.description: Carrying this orb increases Magic XP gains by 10%.

types.name: Utility Belt
types.description: A pocket-space container that can hold up to 20 items.

types.name: Cooking Bag
types.description: A 50-slot pocket-space bag adapted from the integrated cooking bag.

types.name: Book Case
types.description: A portable enchanted book case with thirty storage slots.

types.name: Magic Vault
types.description: A password-protected vault for storing Arcane Essence.

types.name: Locator
types.description: A divination compass that reveals the direction and distance of a character in the same realm.

types.name: Magic Scanner
types.description: A divination lens that reads magical aptitude, essence and mutation signatures.

types.name: Disguise
types.description: A glamour veil that makes the bearer difficult to see for one minute. Combat breaks neither the timer nor the veil.

types.name: Magic Fishing Lure
types.description: Consume beside water to draw ambient magic and aquatic life to the surface.

types.name: Enchanted Doll
types.description: Awaken this construct as a temporary arcane companion.

types.name: Upgrade Kit
types.description: Apply masterwork arcane quality to one Nexus-forged weapon, pair of gloves, mask, or armor.

types.name: Crystal Ball
types.description: Observe a visible character in the same realm for ten seconds.

types.name: Elixir of Health
types.description: Triples natural regeneration for five minutes.

types.name: Elixir of Replenishment
types.description: Doubles natural energy recovery for five minutes.

types.name: Elixir of Merriment
types.description: Increases Progression XP earned from roleplay and chat by 25% for ten minutes.

types.name: Elixir of Life
types.description: Permanently extends the drinker's decline age by 25 years. One effective dose per character.

types.name: Elixir of Empowerment
types.description: Fully restores the drinker and grants 400 Progression XP. One effective dose per character.

types.name: Elixir of Reformation
types.description: Clear character mutations and reopen the native stat-allocation process. One effective dose per character.

types.name: Book of Ages
types.description: Age five years and gain one Milestone Point. One effective reading per character.

types.name: Book of Fortitude
types.description: Reduces damage taken by 15% for ten minutes. One effective reading per character.

types.name: Book of Lessons
types.description: Grants 750 Progression XP from the recorded lessons of the past. One effective reading per character.

types.name: Book of Power
types.description: Permanently increases BP growth by 5% and current base BP by 10%. One effective reading per character.

types.name: Magic Circle
types.description: A portable ritual circle. Keep it in your inventory or stand within two tiles to gather 50% more Arcane Essence.

types.name: Transmutation Circle
types.description: An advanced alchemical circle. It doubles Arcane Essence gathering and can exchange resources or ores.

types.name: Philosopher's Stone
types.description: A masterwork alchemical catalyst. Carrying one grants +0.5 effective Regeneration and perfect language comprehension.

types.name: Stone of Understanding
types.description: An enchanted listening stone. Carrying it makes every non-secret language fully understandable.

types.name: Universal Translator
types.description: A registered language processor. Carrying it makes your spoken language understandable and translates speech you hear.

types.name: Mutagen Injector
types.description: An integrated organic mutagen. It awakens one random 5-12% mutation, up to two mutations per organic character.

types.name: Self-Replicating Code Injector
types.description: A synthetic counterpart to mutagen that awakens one random 5-12% Android mutation.

types.name: Genetic Sequencer
types.description: Analyzes native mutation profiles and can stabilize one awakened mutation by 1%, up to 30%. Stabilization has a ten-minute cooldown.

types.name: Adamantine Skeleton Treatment
types.description: A one-use integrated procedure that permanently reduces incoming damage by 8%. Installation causes an immediate knockout.

types.name: Mutation Suppressant
types.description: A precision genetic treatment that removes one chosen awakened mutation without rerolling the remaining profile.

types.name: Repair Kit
types.description: A one-use integrated repair kit that restores a damaged item's baseline structural integrity. The target must be nearby and unequipped.

types.name: Scientific Upgrade Kit
types.description: A one-use engineering kit that applies masterwork calibration to Nexus-forged equipment.

types.name: Medical Assessment
types.description: A disposable diagnostic package that reports a nearby character's vitals, biological age and mutation profile.

types.name: Prospecting Toolkit
types.description: A one-use ground scanner that reveals one nearby native ore deposit. Mining progression still controls extraction.

types.name: Healing Pylon
types.description: A stationary medical field that increases natural regeneration by 50% within five tiles.

types.name: Android Upgrade Component
types.description: A permanent Android core upgrade. Up to three components each improve BP growth and recovery by 3%.

types.name: Android Chassis
types.description: A reusable synthetic repair shell. An adjacent Android may enter it for a full repair once every ten minutes.

types.name: Scourge Virus
types.description: A sealed vial containing an unidentified fluorescent biological agent.

types.name: Experimental Scourge Treatment
types.description: An experimental antiviral treatment intended to suppress aggressive Viltrumite pathogens.

types.name: Shuriken
types.description: This is a ranged move based on the thrower's strength

types.name: Smoke Bomb
types.description: A pack of toxic smoke pellets that when thrown will grow over time and you can hide in the smoke.

types.name: Flashbang
types.description: A small but powerful flashbang that can blind enemies.

types.name: Daybreaker Virus
types.description: Turns people into vampires.

types.name: T Spider
types.description: x1.2 Strength. 1.2x Accuracy. /1.44 Resistance. Get the advantage and disadvantage of a spider! Also gives a BP boost roughly worth 20 minutes of sparring.

types.name: T Scorpion
types.description: x1.2 Accuracy. /1.2 Reflex. Get the advantage and disadvantage of a scorpion! Also gives a BP boost roughly worth 20 minutes of sparring.

types.name: T Snake
types.description: x1.2 Speed. /1.2 Reflex. Get the advantage and disadvantage of a snake! Also gives a BP boost roughly worth 20 minutes of sparring.

types.name: T Recovery
types.description: Doubles recovery but halves energy.

types.name: T Regeneration
types.description: Doubles regeneration and divides force by 4 permanently making energy almost useless.

types.name: T Energy
types.description: Raises energy to a certain level if it is below that level.

types.name: T Vitality
types.description: Raises durability and resistance immensely.

types.name: T Heal
types.description: Temporarily speeds up regeneration when used.

types.name: T Fusion
types.description: This will increase your battle power but it will slowly wear off. You will be immune to the t virus while this is active. No amount of damage you take will slow you down. The downside is that a bio field generator will kill you like it would a zombie, and there is a 10% chance that injecting this will kill you.

types.name: T Strength
types.description: This will greatly increase strength and speed if they are under certain levels.

types.name: T Undying
types.description: This will boost your death regeneration by 1.3 points (which is a lot), but result in a 25% loss of resistance.

types.name: T Life
types.description: This will slow your decline IMMENSELY. Extending your lifespan nearly 4x its normal amount.

types.name: T Virus Injection
types.description: This is a virus that creates Zombies. Inject someone with it to infect them. Even dead bodies can be brought back to life in a horrible way.

types.name: Super Antivirus
types.description: A concentrated broad-spectrum antiviral. Against highly aggressive infections, treatment success may depend on how quickly it is administered.

types.name: Amulet
types.description: Opens a portal to the dead zone, sucking anything nearby in

types.name: Dragon Ball
types.description: One of the seven Wish Orbs. When all seven are gathered you will be granted a wish

types.name: Gravity
types.description: Place this anywhere on the ground to use it, it will affect anything within its radius.

types.name: Air Mask
types.description: You can survive in space if you equip this

types.name: Final Explosion
types.description: Tap this once to begin charging. Tap it again to unleash an explosion. It will damage you and anyone near you. If you charge it enough you will die.

types.name: Hakai
types.description: Using this on someone will trap them in place and kill them within seconds so long as they have significantly less BP than you. No other stat matters. They have a few seconds to struggle against it if they power up or otherwise raise their BP to a level that you can no longer Hakai them

types.name: PressurePunch
types.description: Concentrate your energy into a powerful punch that can knock back enemies.

types.name: RoundhouseKick
types.description: Concentrate your energy into a powerful punch that can knock back enemies.

types.name: Dropkick
types.description: Channel all your energy into 1 kick, stunning your oponnent and causing a massive damage.

types.name: WolfFangFist
types.description: Lunges at your opponent with five advancing strikes. The sequence stays in contact and its final hit deals medium knockback.

types.name: Make Holy Pendant
types.description: This ability can make pendants that can protect people from the tortures of hell

types.name: Third Eye
types.description: This unlocks your 3rd Eye Chakra. x1.2 BP, x2 meditation bp, x2 skill mastery, /5 zenkai

types.name: Focusin revert
types.description: Use this on yourself or someone in front of you to remove the effects of focusin from them

types.name: Bleeding Edge (Milestone)
types.description: Toggle the integrated Bleeding Edge weapon stance. Weapon strikes can inflict an additional bleed, but attack 10% slower.

types.name: Thundering Blows (Milestone)
types.description: Toggle the integrated Thundering Blows weapon stance. Weapon strikes can create a damaging stagger, but attack 10% slower.

types.name: Venomous Intent (Milestone)
types.description: Toggle a stance with a 25% chance on damaging hits to inflict a twelve-second poison based on maximum Health.

types.name: Crushing Resolve (Milestone)
types.description: Toggle a lethal-only stance. Damaging hits have a 25% chance to spend 1 Willpower and drain 2 from the target, at most once every five seconds.

types.name: Reincarnation
types.description: Use this to reincarnate someone as a 'different person'. They may lose some power and more. Face them and use it.

types.name: Namekian Fusion
types.description: Namekian fusion lets two Namekians fuse together for a power boost. The person who offers the fusion has their character deleted and the other gets the boost.

types.name: Great Ape
types.description: Turns you into a giant ape, which grants certain advantages and disadvantages.

types.name: Heran Transformation
types.description: Unleash a temporary Heran power surge equal to a standard Super Saiyan. The entire gain is additive BP and never exceeds the equivalent Super Saiyan form. Mastering the form removes its Energy upkeep.

types.name: Goo Trap
types.description: You can lay a pile of goo on the map that will try to absorb anyone who gets near it who is weak enough. After absorbing them it will go back to where you originally placed it and do it again until someone destroys it or you make a new one, or you log out.

types.name: Body Swap
types.description: Allows you to jump into another person's body, like Bebi. They must be below 100% health for you to jump into their body, because there must be a cut that you can jump into.

types.name: Overdrive
types.description: Overdrive is a cybernetic ability which allows you to temporarily bypass your limitations, increasing your available cybernetic battle power. Using this will cause you damage.

types.name: Scrap Absorb
types.description: This ability lets you absorb the scraps from dead Androids, to increase your own power. Some of the power is permanent, some of it is temporary.

types.name: Fireball
types.description: Launch a homing sphere that erupts on impact and burns for eight seconds, dealing 2% maximum Health every two seconds and reducing regeneration by 70%.

types.name: Frost Bolt
types.description: Launch a precise freezing bolt that briefly stuns its target.

types.name: Lightning Bolt
types.description: Launch a fast bolt that electrifies for six seconds, dealing 1% maximum Health every two seconds while reducing Accuracy, Reflex and Speed by 15% and causing weak stuns.

types.name: Frost Nova
types.description: Release a freezing pulse that damages and stuns every valid enemy within two tiles.

types.name: Earth Prison
types.description: Raise a five-tile-radius square of temporary, destructible earthen walls around the caster.

types.name: Empowered Attacks
types.description: Empower nearby allies, increasing damage by 10% for 30 seconds.

types.name: Empowered Defenses
types.description: Ward nearby allies, increasing effective Endurance and Resistance by 50% for 30 seconds.

types.name: Accelerate
types.description: Accelerate yourself or an adjacent ally for 30 seconds.

types.name: Rejuvenate
types.description: Restore an adjacent ally without sacrificing the caster's health.

types.name: Gravity Well
types.description: Create a temporary pocket of increased gravity for training.

types.name: Create Portal
types.description: Bind a visited location as an anchor, then open a temporary two-way portal to it.

types.name: Enchant
types.description: Spend Arcane Essence to permanently grant one Nexus-forged item visible masterwork quality and improved combat statistics.

types.name: Arcane Crafting
types.description: Shape gathered Arcane Essence into magical constructs and ritual tools.

types.name: Vampire Bite
types.description: If you have this ability then you are a vampire. Vampires must feed on non-vampires, they get power from doing this. If they do not feed, or if they feed on other vampires, it will cause their hunger to rise even faster, if it reaches 100% they will turn into a Vampire Monster, a vampire that feeds on other vampires as well as non-vampires. Vampires with very high infection will lose control and automatically attack any non-vampires in an attempt to get blood. Vampires have more power than non-vampires, and Vampire Monsters have more power than vampires. If a Vampire Monster's infection reaches 100%, they die.

types.name: Kaioken
types.description: This replaces normal power up. By hitting the power up key you will increase your level by 1. Each level gives more BP than the last but also drains a small amount of Willpower and energy. To use the full abilities of this you must have power control. Kaioken automatically stops before it can break your Willpower. More energy mod and recovery decreases the energy drain, but only slightly. This also reduces flash step cost by half.

types.name: Make DeadZone Amulet
types.description: You can make an amulet, that when used, will open a portal to the deadzone, sucking anything nearby into it. Very, very dangerous.

types.name: Make Wish Orbs
types.description: Scatter will allow you to automatically scatter any Wish Orbs in your inventory across the planet you are on. Wish Orbs command will create any missing Wish Orbs from your set and update all existing Wish Orbs to your current wishing power.

types.name: Mate
types.description: Create a child with another eligible player. Children inherit some attributes from their parent(s), such as base power and energy.

nodes.name: Power Control
nodes.description: Regulate Battle Power, power up and power down before learning more demanding ki applications.

nodes.name: Blast
nodes.description: Learn the fundamental rapid ki projectile used as the basis for ranged combat.

nodes.name: Lunge
nodes.description: Learn the universal committed melee approach used to enter close combat.

nodes.name: Fly
nodes.description: Manipulate ki to levitate and fly, trading Energy for unrestricted movement.

nodes.name: Shield
nodes.description: Shape controlled ki into a defensive barrier that converts incoming damage into Energy drain.

nodes.name: Block
nodes.description: Brace in a timed stance that reduces final damage and improves blast evasion while sacrificing Strength, Force and Reflex.

nodes.name: Meditate Level 2
nodes.description: Deepen meditation into an effective training discipline after learning to regulate your own Battle Power.

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.description: Concentrate a basic blast into a slower explosive projectile with greater commitment.

nodes.name: Shockwave
nodes.description: Release controlled ki and physical force in a radial wave that damages and repels nearby opponents.

nodes.name: Dash Attack
nodes.description: Turn the basic lunge into a controllable line rush that rewards distance and attacking from behind.

nodes.name: Zanzoken
nodes.description: Use a burst of extreme speed to evade, reposition and pursue through an afterimage-like movement technique.

nodes.name: Custom Buff
nodes.description: Create and tune a personal combat buff after mastering safe control of your own ki output.

nodes.name: Beam
nodes.description: Sustain concentrated ki as a controllable energy wave; the basis of named beam techniques.

nodes.name: Sokidan
nodes.description: Shape and guide a Spirit Ball after mastering both ki regulation and sustained energy projection.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.description: A sustained Nexus focus: moderate power, speed, regeneration, and recovery at a continuous energy cost.

nodes.name: Muscle Force
nodes.description: A grounded physical style that reinforces strength and durability.

nodes.name: Magic Force
nodes.description: Arcane circulation improves force, resistance and recovery.

nodes.name: Offensive Stance
nodes.description: A committed attacking posture that trades defense for strength and accuracy.

nodes.name: Defensive Stance
nodes.description: A guarded posture that trades offense for durability and reflex.

nodes.name: Burning Fist
nodes.description: Ignites a relentless close-range rhythm that favors strength and offense.

nodes.name: Demonic Fury
nodes.description: A ferocious style with high power, strength and regeneration but reduced reflex.

nodes.name: Angelic Grace
nodes.description: A serene high-mobility style that improves speed, reflex and recovery.

nodes.name: Channel
nodes.description: Sacrifices movement to expand energy, force and recovery for sustained casting.

nodes.name: High Tension
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring raw power and durability.

nodes.name: Godspeed
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring extreme movement, accuracy, and reflex.

nodes.name: Fists of Fury
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring strength and relentless offense.

nodes.name: Arcane Power
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring energy capacity, force, and recovery.

nodes.name: Bestial Wrath
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring ferocity, strength, and regeneration.

nodes.name: Bushido
nodes.description: An Ultimate Buff favoring balanced weapon combat and precision.

nodes.name: Ki Fist
nodes.description: Wraps the hands in Ki and adds 30% of Force to melee scaling. With a physical weapon this becomes Embue, retaining only the weapon's BP reinforcement.

nodes.name: Ki Sword
nodes.description: Shapes a light Ki blade. Adds 70% of Force to melee scaling and carries a sword accuracy penalty, but does not unlock weapon techniques.

nodes.name: Ki Hammer
nodes.description: Shapes a heavy Ki hammer. Adds 100% of Force to melee scaling, counts as a weapon and trades speed and accuracy for impact.

nodes.name: Spirit Sword
nodes.description: The highest Ki Weapon discipline. Adds 70% of Force to melee scaling, attacks Resistance through energy and counts as a weapon.

nodes.name: Slice
nodes.description: A fast weapon strike with regular damage and a very short cooldown.

nodes.name: Bash
nodes.description: Bash with a hammer or sword pommel, sacrificing damage to stun the target.

nodes.name: Flourish
nodes.description: An elaborate weapon strike that converts speed into stronger impact.

nodes.name: Wind Howl
nodes.description: Unleash a true area slicing shockwave that strikes enemies within three tiles without requiring a selected target.

nodes.name: Iai Slash
nodes.description: Rush up to six tiles and strike through the target with a speed-amplified slash.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.description: Ready your equipped weapon and counter the next incoming melee attack within four seconds.

nodes.name: Cleave
nodes.description: Sweep the three tiles in front of you with increased accuracy and damage.

nodes.name: Sword Stab
nodes.description: A focused stab that pierces the adjacent target and a second target directly behind them.

nodes.name: Overhead Smash
nodes.description: A heavy, less accurate overhead attack that crashes through three tiles in a straight line.

nodes.name: Colossal Impact
nodes.description: Drive your weapon down and unleash a gigantic close-range shockwave.

nodes.name: Burning Slash
nodes.description: A three-hit weapon combo whose finishing strike tears open a bleeding wound.

nodes.name: Critical Edge
nodes.description: Adopt a weapon-exclusive stance for twelve seconds, adding 15 percentage points to melee critical chance.

nodes.name: Echoing Slash
nodes.description: A fast weapon swing that launches a physical cutting wave with sword audiovisuals and no blast explosion.

nodes.name: Sky Break
nodes.description: A weapon swing that breaks the sound barrier and launches a Strength-scaled cutting blast.

nodes.name: Headbutt
nodes.description: A blunt close-range strike with a brief stagger.

nodes.name: Uppercut Combo
nodes.description: A three-hit rising combination whose final uppercut launches the target.

nodes.name: Axe Kick
nodes.description: A descending kick with strong knockback.

nodes.name: Kickback Combo
nodes.description: Knock the target away, pursue them with afterimages and land a second hit unless they block.

nodes.name: March of Fury
nodes.description: The combo route's peak pursuit technique, resolving four attacks for the highest sustained unarmed damage.

nodes.name: Pile Driver
nodes.description: Requires a grabbed opponent; invert and slam them head-first with an unavoidable impact.

nodes.name: Megaton Throw
nodes.description: Requires a grabbed opponent; leap with them, slam them down and throw them away.

nodes.name: Consecutive Normal Punches
nodes.description: Telegraph briefly, then unleash six separately resolved unarmed hits on an adjacent target.

nodes.name: Exploding Heart Strike
nodes.description: The precision route's capstone strike, combining heavy direct damage with internal bleeding.

nodes.name: Texas Smash
nodes.description: The impact route's peak single blow, trading accuracy for devastating raw damage and knockback.

nodes.name: Guard Break
nodes.description: Adopt an unarmed stance for ten seconds. Your next three landed melee attacks each reduce the target's effective Reflex by 10% for eight seconds, stacking to 30%.

nodes.name: Wing Clip
nodes.description: Sweep every opponent within two tiles with an unavoidable low-damage kick, knocking them back and reducing Speed by 25% for eight seconds.

nodes.name: Sand Throw
nodes.description: Scatter sand around you with unavoidable accuracy, reducing nearby opponents' Accuracy and Reflex by 20% for eight seconds.

nodes.name: Burning Shot
nodes.description: Warp into range and land a fiery three-hit unarmed combination.

nodes.name: Blue Comet Special
nodes.description: A speed-focused advancing assault adapted as a long-range five-hit rush.

nodes.name: Comet Reversal
nodes.description: Counter a hostile beam from the front, rush its owner and strike on reaching them.

nodes.name: PressurePunch
nodes.description: A peak impact strike with a raw physical factor of 6 and extreme knockback.

nodes.name: RoundhouseKick
nodes.description: Concentrate your energy into a powerful punch that can knock back enemies.

nodes.name: Dropkick

nodes.name: Fly
nodes.description: Obviously this lets you fly. But it drains energy to do so. The more you use it the more you master it, and the more you master it, the less it drains. Also you can decrease the drain to a lesser level by simply gaining more energy, but the effect is not the same as mastering the move itself. This will let you move much faster than you can by walking.

nodes.name: Power Control
nodes.description: This allows you to power up and power down. Also, for certain forms, such as those of Saiyans and Frost Lords, powering up twice will cause them to go into their next form, powering down twice will cause them to revert. Powering up will increase your Battle Power, but drain your energy the higher you go. Energy Efficiency determines how far above 100% you can go before the upkeep begins increasing sharply.

nodes.name: Materialize
nodes.description: This ability lets you create weighted clothes to accelerate training and also create swords. Your energy mod will improve the quality of weights you make.

nodes.name: Unlock Potential
nodes.description: Using this on someone will greatly increase their power and energy. Each use will add 5 years to how long you must wait to use it on someone again.

nodes.name: Keep Body
nodes.description: Using this on someone will allow them to keep most of their power while dead.

nodes.name: Restore Youth
nodes.description: You can use this to make someone younger. Each time they get this done they get less and less from it.

nodes.name: Revive
nodes.description: This will bring someone back to life. Just face them and use it

nodes.name: Bind
nodes.description: You can use this to bind someone to hell. You can only bind a person who is less than your own power at the time. The stronger they are compared to you the more energy it will drain to bind them

nodes.name: Make Power Fruit
nodes.description: With this you can make fruits that will increase the power and energy of those who eat them, along with a temporary boost to regeneration and recovery. The more of them you eat however, the less of an effect they will have each time.

nodes.name: Kai Teleport
nodes.description: Teleport to any planet. This will drain all your energy. Anyone who is beside you will be taken with you.

nodes.name: Make Holy Pendant
nodes.description: This ability can make pendants that can protect people from the tortures of hell

nodes.name: Meditate Level 2
nodes.description: Meditate Level 2 allows you to use meditation as a form of training. Without this skill, meditate is only good for recovering health and energy faster.

nodes.name: Telepathy
nodes.description: Learn Telepathy through the Kaioshin lineage.

nodes.name: Observe
nodes.description: Learn Observe through the Kaioshin lineage.

nodes.name: Reincarnation
nodes.description: Use this to reincarnate someone as a 'different person'. They may lose some power and more. Face them and use it.

nodes.name: Sense Level 1
nodes.description: The ability to sense everyone on the planet. You can see their overall power, which is their BP, stats, and everything else combined into a percent.

nodes.name: Sense Level 2
nodes.description: By clicking on someone you will open a tab which will let you see their overall power, health, and energy, and possibly other details that basic sense does not tell you.

nodes.name: Shadow Spar
nodes.description: This is a special form of training where your character is being attacked by an imaginary target and you must face them in time to defend yourself. It is quite a good method of training but requires you to actually be active.

nodes.name: Mystic
nodes.description: Learn Mystic through the Kaioshin lineage.

nodes.name: Focusin revert
nodes.description: Use this on yourself or someone in front of you to remove the effects of focusin from them

nodes.name: Hakai
nodes.description: Erase a target with Hakai. This apex racial technique requires every final Kaioshin route and 3300 lifetime Progression XP.

nodes.name: Blast
nodes.description: Fire blasts rapidly

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.description: An explosive one-shot energy attack that takes a few seconds to charge.

nodes.name: Explosion
nodes.description: This attack causes an explosion on the ground, the more you use it the bigger the explosion

nodes.name: Beam
nodes.description: Learn Beam through the Daimao lineage.

nodes.name: Spin Blast
nodes.description: Shoot many small blasts in every direction continuously

nodes.name: Sokidan
nodes.description: A guided energy bomb that deals equal impact and splash damage and cannot damage its owner.

nodes.name: Makankosappo
nodes.description: Learn Makankosappo through the Daimao lineage.

nodes.name: Self Destruct
nodes.description: Using this will kill you. It is an extremely powerful attack, one of the top 3 at least. It will affect a large area. If you have death regeneration this attack is much weaker.

nodes.name: Genocide
nodes.description: This is a very weak attack, about the power of a single blast, but each one homes in on your selected target across the planet. Press it once to begin firing, again to stop.

nodes.name: Shield
nodes.description: You can toggle this on and off. A ki shield will surround you to protect you from all attacks. Each attack will drain your energy instead of health. The shield will also protect you from dying in space but it will drain energy heavily.

nodes.name: SplitForm
nodes.description: This will make a copy of yourself, made of energy. It has much the same power as you, and makes a good sparring partner or assistant in battle. You can command their actions by clicking on them. When one is destroyed by someone you lose health and energy. You can not recover health or energy while they are out.

nodes.name: Make DeadZone Amulet
nodes.description: You can make an amulet, that when used, will open a portal to the deadzone, sucking anything nearby into it. Very, very dangerous.

nodes.description: Using this on someone will allow them to keep most of their power while dead.

nodes.name: Majin
nodes.description:
Majin does the following:
20% BP increase
20% stronger anger
x1.5 drain from all attacks
Decreased delay between lunge attacks

nodes.name: Shockwave
nodes.description: This emits a shockwave that will knockback anyone within range, dealing some damage. It does damage based on your strength + force, compared to the target's durability + resistance

nodes.description: An offensive and defensive move that makes many balls of ki swarm around you and whatever enters the barrier will be attacked by them. Press the command once to begin firing the balls, press it again when you feel you have fired enough. The more you fire the more it will drain your energy. This ability protects the user from all explosion damage.

nodes.description:
Using this will make you bigger:
20% bp increase (50% for makyos)
25% speed, reflex, offense decrease
25% strength, endurance, and resist increase

nodes.name: Viltrumite Rush
nodes.description: Surge up to seven tiles into a target. The impact opens their guard, enables Relentless Pursuit and briefly staggers them against solid terrain.

nodes.name: Rib Breaker
nodes.description: Drive a compact strike into an adjacent target, briefly staggering them and creating a personal combat opening.

nodes.name: Relentless Pursuit
nodes.description: Consume the pursuit window on a target you recently launched and close up to ten tiles without dealing damage.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Grip
nodes.description: Seize an adjacent unguarded opponent after a low-damage strike, preparing them for a grapple technique.

nodes.name: Meteor Drop
nodes.description: Requires a grabbed opponent. Rise with them and drive them into the ground, opening and briefly staggering them.

nodes.name: Spear Hand
nodes.description: A focused adjacent hand thrust with high damage, no knockback and severe bleeding. Combat openings improve its accuracy.

nodes.name: Nolan's Combination
nodes.description: Close four tiles and attempt four individually resolved strikes, ending in a bleeding knife-hand slash. Blocking or evading interrupts the sequence.

nodes.name: Executioner's Hand
nodes.description: Passive Viltrumite mastery: Spear Hand gains 25% damage and heavier bleeding against KO or critically wounded targets while you fight lethally.

nodes.name: Viltrumite Guard
nodes.description: Brace for two seconds. The next frontal attack deals 40% less final damage and gives you a personal opening against its attacker.

nodes.name: Punishing Reversal
nodes.description: For one second, counter the next frontal melee attack with a low-damage elbow that staggers and creates a combat opening.
